name: Girl Doll Toy ~Tamashii o Kudasai~
original_name: Girl Doll Toy ～魂をください～
source:
Near future. Hero works in a laboratory developing human-like androids. He picks up an android that was fated to be disposed, upgraded her and named her Erika. At some point he starts to feel romantic emotions for her...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
